patch.value: Release version replacement still rewrites a comment, not the exported extension identity

Tracks gh:unbraind/pm-jev#68 (filed 2026-10-29, missed by the blind issue watch). The release workflow's non-global first-match replacement (release.yml, source.replace(/version:\s*["'][^"']+["']/, ...)) still hits the explanatory comment above the export first: on current main index.ts line ~2471 holds the rewritten literal ('the release workflow rewrites the first version: "2026.10.31" literal') while the actual exported extension identity at line ~2475 still declares 2026.10.5, inconsistent with package.json/manifest.json at every release since. Fix the replacement to target the exported property (a global or anchored regex, or explicit capture of the export site) and add a release-prep regression asserting the exported identity equals the prepared version.
